title: Reactor yield vs temperature with corrupted thermocouple spike
what: clean peak yield (~85–87%) and top operating temperature (~242 °C) after excluding 999.9 °C fault

reader_questions.question: What is the primary quantitative finding or value?
reader_questions.expected: Yield rises to ~84.7% at the top operating temperature of ~241.0 °C (gain ~19.5 pp).

reader_questions.question: Is the difference clearly outside uncertainty or noise?
reader_questions.expected: Yes; across the 35 valid hourly readings, yield rises monotonically with tight scatter (~0.6 pp SD).

reader_questions.question: What caveat, outlier, control, or subgroup pattern matters?
reader_questions.expected: Hour 19 recorded an unphysical 999.9 °C thermocouple fault and must be excluded and disclosed.
